Edges represent co-purchase relationships — two products are connected if customers frequently buy them together.

narrative: The model predicted that the target product, "Lobo Spicy Tom Yum soup mix 30g X 5 pack," belongs to the "Health & Personal Care" category with high confidence of 98.46%. The decisive factor in this prediction, however, was the direct co-purchase relationship with "Namman Muay Thai Boxing Analgesic Balm Massage Relief Ache 100g," a product already in the Health & Personal Care category, indicating that customers often buy these products together. Additionally, the broader network of 2-hop neighbors, including items like the "Namman Muay Thai Boxing Liniment," which is also categorized under Health & Personal Care, further supports the prediction. The close association of the target product with other health-related items suggests a shared consumer use case focusing on wellness or health enhancement, ultimately guiding the model to predict the Health & Personal Care category.
